repository.reconciliation_rule: Repository reality wins. Before implementation, require the expected branch, reconcile any HEAD/content drift, and preserve unknown edits.

accepted_specification.behavior: YAML is an explicitly applied editable source and interchange representation over the canonical DesignDocument.
accepted_specification.source_of_truth: The existing validated DesignDocument object and JSON/revision persistence model remain canonical.
accepted_specification.round_trip: Semantic DesignDocument equality only; comments, author formatting, scalar spelling, and key order are not persisted.

authority.required_next_authorization: Explicitly authorize DSA-PROD-003 implementation against this request after reconciling its base identity.

included_scope: Add one shared strict YAML codec that converts between text and the existing DesignDocument and returns stable structured diagnostics.

Add an authenticated editor YAML source surface with generated source, Validate, Preview, Apply and save, Reset from design, Download YAML, Close, unsaved-change protection, and accessible mobile/desktop behavior.
Add .yaml and .yml native-document import in the browser workspace through the shared codec.
Add YAML as a lossless textual browser and authenticated server export format through the shared codec.
Add CLI YAML input/output, extension detection, explicit stdin format, document get, project import/export, and offline render-output support.
Advertise the YAML format through existing REST/API reference, MCP/WebMCP capability inventories, CLI help, official docs, agent skill, and generated llms outputs.
Add focused codec, server, CLI, UI, accessibility, security, documentation, and JSON regression tests and update E2E test-plan routing.
excluded_scope: YAML as canonical or database persistence
Persisted comments, lexical formatting, scalar spelling, key order, anchors, or aliases
Collaborative or textual YAML merge and live source co-editing
Raw application/yaml REST request bodies or a new import endpoint
A YAML-specific product schema, schema-version system, or best-effort unknown-field dropping
Provider prompt/output changes or automatic AI-generated YAML application
Templates, variables, includes, macros, expressions, executable tags, scripts, environment interpolation, or remote references
Unrelated editor/API redesign, refactoring, dependency upgrades, or product features

requirements.statement: Implement parseDocumentYaml and stringifyDocumentYaml in one shared module; both must pass values through documentSchema and never duplicate the DesignDocument field schema.

Parse exactly one UTF-8 YAML 1.2 document with a 2 MiB input ceiling and depth limit 100; reject aliases, anchors, merge keys, explicit/custom tags, duplicate keys, non-string mapping keys, multiple documents, non-finite or non-JSON values, cyclic/shared references, undefined/date/binary/map/set values, and prototype-pollution keys.
Return stable diagnostic codes with path and YAML line/column when available; never log or render source as HTML.
Provide explicit Validate and Preview actions that do not mutate editor or server state, and Apply and save through the existing full-document revision/brief-revision guarded save path.
Preserve the YAML buffer on validation/save failure or revision conflict; require explicit discard/reset when local visual edits would replace changed source.
Use the shared codec for browser import/export, server export, and CLI YAML flows while retaining unchanged JSON behavior.

Disclose that comments and formatting are session-only and not persisted; generated YAML is deterministic, two-space indented, block-sequence formatted, final-newline terminated, and contains no generated anchors.
Keep server authorization, project identity/kind, asset ownership, topology/evolution, schemaVersion, and optimistic revision validation authoritative.
Synchronize public clients and documentation from owning sources and regenerate derived documentation/bundles rather than hand-editing generated output.

acceptance_criteria.description: Representative valid schemaVersion 1 and 2 documents parse from YAML and validate as DesignDocument values.

For catalog templates and representative creative, motion, and 3D documents, parseDocumentYaml(stringifyDocumentYaml(doc)) deep-equals documentSchema.parse(doc), and JSON-to-YAML-to-JSON preserves every supported value.
Malformed YAML and every prohibited YAML/non-JSON feature are rejected before mutation, including size/depth and prototype-pollution cases.
Syntax and schema failures expose stable error codes, document paths, and YAML line/column where available without including full source in logs or telemetry.
Validate and Preview never mutate local canonical editor state, persistence, revision, brief revision, or publication state.
Apply is explicit and saves only at the exact observed project and applicable brief revision; stale revisions fail with actionable reconciliation while preserving source.
Browser .yaml/.yml import, browser/server YAML export, and CLI YAML input/output use the shared codec with correct filenames, content type, stdin format requirements, and structured failures.
The source workflow discloses comment/format loss, protects unsaved source, supports keyboard and screen-reader error navigation, works at mobile and desktop sizes, and retains a textarea fallback.
Existing JSON imports, exports, CLI commands, REST/MCP/WebMCP document writes, revision conflicts, rendering, and publication behavior remain backward compatible.
Owning documentation, API/format inventories, CLI help, agent skill, llms sources/derived outputs, generated assets, and E2E test routing are synchronized and verified.

dependency_changes.reason: YAML 1.2 Document AST, diagnostics, deterministic serialization, and bounded conversion; pin exact version and update package-lock.json.
constraints: Set alias expansion limit to zero and independently reject anchors/aliases
Audit shipped dependency and license locally

covers: mapped browser and always-run security coverage

verification_plan.procedure: Inspect actual YAML downloads and exercise source editor at representative mobile and desktop viewports. Report only browsers actually run; Chromium-only evidence does not establish cross-browser support.

rollback.strategy: Revert the focused YAML implementation commit(s), removing format registration, UI, shared codec, yaml dependency, tests, and source documentation together.
rollback.data: No migration or stored-project rollback is required because persistence remains JSON.

known_risks.risk: Parser features or resource expansion create denial-of-service or unsafe object shapes.
known_risks.mitigation: AST-level feature rejection, zero aliases, duplicate-key rejection, JSON-only conversion, prototype-key rejection, 2 MiB/depth limits, tests, exact dependency pin.

known_risks.risk: Users expect comments or formatting to persist.
known_risks.mitigation: Disclose semantic-only behavior at source entry and before apply; test reset/reload behavior.

known_risks.risk: A full-document source apply overwrites concurrent or unsaved changes.
known_risks.mitigation: Snapshot revisions, explicit apply, existing CAS/brief guards, preserve buffer on failure, no autosave, conflict recovery.

known_risks.risk: Format support drifts across browser, server, CLI, MCP/WebMCP, and docs.
known_risks.mitigation: Single codec and export enum plus parity/documentation tests and generated-source ownership.

known_risks.risk: Large source UI is difficult on mobile or inaccessible.
known_risks.mitigation: Full-screen mobile layout, textarea fallback, keyboard/focus/error semantics, mobile and desktop E2E.

unresolved_non_blocking.question: Use a plain textarea initially or an existing lightweight editor abstraction?
unresolved_non_blocking.resolution_rule: Prefer textarea unless focused UI review proves an existing dependency-free abstraction meets accessibility and bundle constraints; do not add a second editor dependency.

unresolved_non_blocking.question: What telemetry event names should source actions use?
unresolved_non_blocking.resolution_rule: Follow src/app/analytics.ts naming/privacy conventions; record actions and error codes only, never YAML content.

unresolved_non_blocking.question: Is 2 MiB and depth 100 the final limit?
unresolved_non_blocking.resolution_rule: Keep these specified ceilings unless existing representative valid documents exceed them in tests; any change requires evidence and must remain below the existing 10 MiB browser import ceiling.
